goal: Atualizar integralmente o design do CVG Connect Desk para um layout premium State of Art, fluido, responsivo, acessível e interativo, baseado na identidade pesquisada do Centro Veterinário Guarapiranga e no logo licenciado fornecido, usando OpenDesign, ComfyUI e Blender sem regredir funcionalidades.

sources.location: Current user request and supplied logo
sources.license_notes: User states the supplied mark is registered/licensed and explicitly authorizes its use.
Used for visual observation and product truth; public photography is not copied.

criteria.conditions: light product theme; all primary routes
criteria.license_notes: The user explicitly authorized the supplied registered/licensed logo on 2026-09-12. Preserve the complete mark; do not invent derivative red-cross emblems.
criteria.target: Uses the observed CVG blue family and Pulso Operacional territory consistently; uses the supplied authorized logo intact at appropriate identity points; contains no invented institutional claim or new derivative red-cross emblem.
criteria.evidence_method: Token audit, source inspection, screenshots at login/inbox/dashboard, fresh visual critic.

baseline.actual: Generic blue/purple plus WhatsApp-green; emoji identity; no coherent brand system.

criteria.validity_notes: Palette is observed from the public site; the logo license/ownership is user-attested and the source file was supplied directly.

criteria.source: Current redesign request and existing public routes in apps/desk-web/src/App.tsx
criteria.conditions: Current frontend route and API contracts
criteria.target: All existing routes and implemented user flows remain wired; frontend unit suite, typecheck and production build pass after integration.
criteria.evidence_method: Route/source audit plus pnpm --filter @cvg/desk-web test, typecheck and build; applicable Playwright flow when environment permits.

baseline.actual: 47/47 frontend tests pass; typecheck and build pass on 2026-09-12.

criteria.validity_notes: Existing tests do not cover every route and are supplemented by route inspection.

criteria.conditions: 375, 390, 768, 1024 and 1440 CSS px; all primary routes, with smartphone and tablet treated as first-class layouts
criteria.target: The web app is multiplatform and purpose-built for smartphone and tablet as well as desktop: no document-level horizontal overflow; safe-area aware navigation and touch targets remain reachable; master/detail routes use a coherent single-panel model below desktop; wide workspaces use contained touch-friendly scrolling; primary operations have touch and keyboard alternatives.
criteria.evidence_method: Browser measurements and screenshots at every declared viewport, plus interaction with mobile navigation and Inbox panels.

baseline.actual: 375px Inbox document scrollWidth is 753px; fixed 240px shell plus 380px conversation list.

criteria.validity_notes: Authenticated baseline used synthetic API responses for layout only.

criteria.conditions: Keyboard, visible focus, reduced motion, semantic names, 200% zoom and key contrast pairs
criteria.target: Primary redesigned paths are keyboard-operable; form controls have names; status is not color-only; focus is visible; reduced motion removes continuous/decorative motion; key text/control contrast meets AA.
criteria.evidence_method: Browser keyboard pass, semantic/source inspection, reduced-motion screenshot, contrast report and tests for named controls.

baseline.actual: Login has unlabeled fields; clickable div rows; no reduced-motion query; multiple observed contrast failures.

criteria.validity_notes: Automated/static checks do not replace manual keyboard inspection.

criteria.source: State of Art / Premium / Triplo AAA request
criteria.conditions: Current integrated login, shell, inbox and dashboard renders
criteria.license_notes: References guide principles only; no protected composition copying.
criteria.target: A coherent product-specific design system with controlled hierarchy, spacing, typography, material, density and SVG iconography; no generic AI styling or emoji-dependent primary navigation/actions; fresh critics identify no Critical or High visual gap.
criteria.evidence_method: Rendered state matrix, design-token audit, two fresh-context visual critics and final critic.

baseline.actual: Fragmented global cascade, emoji navigation, inconsistent palettes and generic login styling.

criteria.validity_notes: AAA is withheld unless independent rendered evidence satisfies this gate.

criteria.source: Requested fluidity, texture, movement and interaction
criteria.target: Motion communicates hierarchy or state, uses named properties and bounded timing, has no distracting continuous UI animation, and is disabled or simplified under reduced motion.
criteria.evidence_method: CSS audit and browser inspection in normal/reduced motion modes.

baseline.actual: 38 transition:all usages and three infinite login animations remain active under reduced motion.

criteria.validity_notes: Short status pulses may remain only when they stop and carry meaning.

criteria.source: Explicit request to use ComfyUI, Blender and open-design MCPs
criteria.conditions: Local generation/editable concept; assets used only when they improve the product
criteria.license_notes: Generated assets must avoid third-party identity and embedded text. The supplied authorized logo may be used intact but must not be hallucinated or redrawn by generators.
criteria.target: OpenDesign produces an editable product concept/specification; ComfyUI produces a provenance-tracked texture; Blender produces a provenance-tracked isolated abstract scene/render or records a current connection blocker without false substitution. Final runtime has performant fallbacks.
criteria.evidence_method: MCP run IDs/status, artifact paths/hashes, asset manifest and runtime source audit.

baseline.actual: No project-native visual assets. OpenDesign and ComfyUI available; interactive Blender MCP connection initially refused at localhost:9876.

criteria.validity_notes: A blocker prevents PASS; capability presence alone is insufficient.

criteria.source: Operational workstation UX and design-director frontend gates
criteria.conditions: Production build and representative local route
criteria.target: Production build succeeds; generated visual assets are responsive and budgeted; LCP <= 2500ms and CLS <= 0.10 when measurable; route-level loading does not regress interaction or error visibility.
criteria.evidence_method: Build sizes, asset audit and browser performance capture when runtime is available.

baseline.actual: Build size observed at 286.62kB JS / 82.60kB gzip and 59.70kB CSS / 11.28kB gzip; LCP/CLS not run.

criteria.validity_notes: Unavailable representative runtime is BLOCKED, not PASS.
